title: Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly 2026 (holdout)

SPA.note: DMK-led Secular Progressive Alliance: 2021 partners all stayed (weight 1 vs AE2021); DMDK joined 19 Feb 2026 from the 2021 AMMK front (tau); MNM supports but does not contest (24 Mar 2026). MDMK contested AE2021 on DMK symbol (no separate AE share) but separately at GE2024

NDA.note: AIADMK+BJP reunited 11 Apr 2025 (contested GE2024 in two separate fronts - ge sums both); PMK formally joined 7 Jan 2026, AMMK 21 Jan 2026 (AMMK contested AE2021 separately -> tau; was in BJP front at GE2024 -> 1). Seat deal finalized 23 Mar 2026

TVK.note: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (Vijay), first election, refused NDA on 18 Mar 2026; zero electoral base -> M2 structurally ~0, only M3 (polls) sees it. Known engine limitation for new entrants

poll_corrections.rule: 0.5 x mean of TN ledger errors (actual - final-window polled): DMK bloc +0.29 (2016), -2.93 (2021) -> -0.66; ADMK bloc +4.00 (2016, only pct obs) -> +2.0; TVK new -> 0

quality_flags: ALL three pre-freeze polls are unrated agencies; Agni News Agency is an outlier/quality symptom (SPA 44.9 pct + '180+ seats' projection on a claimed n=101,643) but is kept mechanically - no cherry-picking at freeze.

TVK (polling 10-15 pct) has zero AE/GE base: M2 cannot see it, and the vote it draws will shift both main blocs in ways the baseline-shift sim does not model. This election is a stress test of the engine's new-entrant blind spot.
NTK (6.7 pct AE2021, 8.2 pct GE2024) contests all 234 alone but has no poll column (lumped in Others); not modeled as a bloc.
Spellings: TMC(M) carries 0.95 at GE2024; AMMK below reporting threshold at GE2024 (contributes ~0).
